names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νεκτάριος “ἐπίσκοπος ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”», with the rank word left off. The epithet «ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ» is the page's own and it offers no other.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1590, «Преподобный Нектарий Печерский», with the rank word left off, and the title of its life page 3249, which gives the same form. The day line declines it, «Нектария Печерского». «Печерский» is the by-name saint.gr renders as «ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ», in the Cave, which is this folder's display name.

feast.note: His name page and his life page both head «Дни памяти: 28 сентября (Печер.(Б)) , 29 ноября», the September day being the synaxis of the fathers of the Near Caves. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Нектария Печерского (XII).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νεκτάριος “ἐπίσκοπος ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn, no distich and no year. Its whole entry is one sentence saying that it has no details of the life of this Russian venerable father; it does not name the cave or the see, and this folder names neither on its behalf. The corpus keeps eight other folders whose personal name is Nectarios or Nectarius and none of them is a bishop of a cave.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).

floruit.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line with a Roman numeral and its life says the same in words — «Прп. Нектария Печерского (XII).» and «подвизался в XII веке», he struggled in the twelfth century. That is a century of life and not a year of death, so it is recorded as a floruit; saint.gr printed no year at all.
